turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on he, she and it with -s?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Yes. For habits and routines with he, she or it, add -s to the verb: he works. With -sh, -ch, -s, -x, -o, add -es: she teaches. Consonant + y becomes -ies: he studies.

Start here: My sister ___ (play) tennis on Sundays. Write only the verb.
